subject: harvestman
title: Daddy Longlegs Have No Venom, Yet They're Caught Eating Live Frogs

scenes.text: This harmless arachnid has been caught eating frogs.
Daddy longlegs, or harvestmen, have no venom, no fangs and spin no webs.
Yet on a night hike in Ecuador, someone found one feeding on a live frog about its own size.
Scientists have now gathered ten cases across South America. In several, the frog was still alive.
Their armoured bodies and spiny mouthparts may help them pin down slippery prey.
The one in your garden eats tiny bugs. Its tropical cousins go after frogs.

description:
Daddy longlegs have no venom and no silk, yet they have been photographed eating live frogs.
A 2026 study in Ecology and Evolution gathered ten cases from South America, including a harvestman in Ecuador feeding on a frog about its own size.
Would you still call them harmless?
first_comment: Harvestmen are night hunters, most active between midnight and 3 a.m., which is why almost nobody sees them eating. Did you grow up thinking daddy longlegs were dangerous?
